artifact: FSAR S2 TRAIN Candidate Universe Protocol V1
gold_mapping: Each TRAIN pair maps its counselor response to exactly one normalized response_uid.
negative_exclusion_rule: Exclude every occurrence that normalizes to the gold response text.
reason_same_dialogue_not_excluded: The retrieval task is fixed-pool response selection. Same-dialogue non-gold responses remain legitimate non-gold candidates; no psychological incorrectness is assumed.
next_gate: Candidate universe and gold mapping must pass exact structural audit before any embedding or dense mining.
